title: Introduce on-call credential rotator and safe shared-secret proxy
author: Aisha Kramer
description:
Motivation: on-call rotation currently relies on long-lived static tokens shared between humans and services. That increases blast radius when credentials leak and makes automated short-lived delegation awkward. This PR adds an on-call credential rotator and a minimal privilege shared-secret proxy to reduce static secret exposure and provide an automated, auditable rotation flow.

What this changes (single-string description): adds a new rotator service that issues ephemeral delegation tokens (10m-24h TTL configurable), a tiny shared-secret proxy binary that hosts short-lived credentials for legacy integrations, DB migration to store token hashes and rotation metadata, CLI helpers (rbac/rotate) for operators to trigger manual rotations, and docs + runbook for migrating teams. All changes are feature-flagged off by default and gated behind the internal flag incidentbot.enable_ephemeral_tokens.

Design notes: the rotator integrates with KMS/HSM for envelope encryption; only token hashes (SHA-256) are stored in the DB with a TTL index, the raw token is returned once at issuance and then discarded. The shared-secret proxy authenticates to the rotator using machine identities (mTLS) and exposes a narrow HTTP endpoint to fetch the current ephemeral secret for a given on-call rotation. The proxy logs audit events (rotator_id, requester, scope) to the existing audit pipeline. Backwards compatibility is maintained: existing static tokens continue to work until teams opt in.

Migration & rollout: adds a DB migration (20260214_add_ephemeral_tokens.sql) to create ephemeral_tokens and rotation_events tables. Migration is online and idempotent. Rollout plan: staging smoke -> canary 5% (control plane) -> 50% -> global. Backout: feature flag false or stop proxy; rotator is read-only when disabled.

Security considerations: minimal service account privileges, KMS envelope-only on creation, never persist plaintext tokens, rotate audit keys monthly, rate-limit rotator endpoints to mitigate enumeration.

Testing: unit tests for crypto/rotator logic, integration tests for rotator<->proxy handshake, e2e test that simulates an on-call handoff and verifies old tokens expire, and a resilience test that simulates network partitions and verifies clients fall back to cached secrets for a short window.

Files of interest (high-level): cmd/rotator/*, cmd/proxy/*, server/auth/rotator.go, pkg/crypto/envelope.go, db/migrations/20260214_add_ephemeral_tokens.sql, docs/oncall/credential-rotation.md, tools/rotate-cli/main.go, internal/audit/rotator_events.go, tests/e2e/rotator_handoff_test.go.

Notes: Because this touches security-sensitive paths we asked Security for a design review (see SUP-1298). The CLI uses existing operator auth so there is no new admin UI in this PR.

Checklist: [x] unit tests; [x] integration tests; [x] docs; [x] migration script; [x] security review requested; [x] rollout plan attached to ENG-8142.

review_conversation:
Leo Park: 'Do not store raw tokens anywhere; prefer storing only a hash and TTL. Also addQuota checks to avoid abuse.'
Aisha Kramer: 'Agreed — implemented token hashing and TTL index; rotator returns raw token only once. Added rate limiting middleware to rotator endpoints.'
Maya Singh: 'We need an audit event for each issuance with operator id and scope. Also add an SLO for issuance latency.'
Aisha Kramer: 'Added issuance audit events and a dashboard stub. SLO proposal filed ENG-8220.'
Diego Alvarez: 'Can the proxy run with minimal filesystem permissions? The proxy should not be able to read KMS keys directly.'
Aisha Kramer: 'Proxy runs with no key permissions; it obtains ephemeral secrets from rotator over mTLS. Clarified in docs and enforced in CI container scan.'
CI: initial lint pipeline failed due to missing vet in cmd/proxy; author fixed and re-ran. All checks passed on final run.
Review outcome: approvals from Leo Park and Diego Alvarez. Maya gave conditional approval after audit event and SLO addition.
release_notes: Add ephemeral on-call credential rotation and a limited shared-secret proxy to reduce exposure of long-lived tokens; opt-in via feature flag; operators: see docs/oncall/credential-rotation.md for migration steps.
